criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 4 November 2028 (18 months after the 4 May 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the long-stop date as 23 May 2027 (90 days after signing on 22 February 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 7 July 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (4 November 2028), with days remaining from 16 March 2027 (599 days).
Notes that 4 November 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 6 November 2028.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
